title: Performance Feedback - Quality Issues Causing Rework
agent_context: Employee’s work has repeated quality issues leading to rework and delays. Use specific examples + impact, listen for root causes, then set clear expectations and a short improvement plan with support and check-ins.

raw_content.initial_message: I’m surprised you’re saying this. I’m doing a lot already — and I don’t think my work is worse than anyone else’s.
raw_content.context: 1:1 performance feedback. Pattern: recurring errors, incomplete handoffs, and missed acceptance criteria causing rework for peers. Policy: keep feedback behavior-based and specific (SBI), avoid comparisons, invite employee perspective, clarify definition of done, agree a time-bound improvement plan (checklist/review/training) with weekly check-ins. Do not threaten; focus on standards + support.

learning_objectives: Deliver clear, specific feedback without blame
Diagnose root causes (clarity, workload, skill gaps, process)
Set measurable expectations and an improvement plan with cadence
correct_sop_steps: Set supportive intent and purpose for the conversation
Share 2–3 specific examples of quality gaps and explain impact (rework/delays)
Invite their perspective and listen to understand root causes
Clarify expectations and define ‘done’ (acceptance criteria, completeness, review steps)
Co-create a short improvement plan with support (checklist, peer review, training) and timeline
Agree on measurement and schedule weekly check-ins
common_mistakes: Making it personal (labels) instead of behavior-based
Arguing about fairness or comparing to peers
No measurable plan or follow-up cadence

must_demonstrate: Uses specific examples and explains business/team impact
Invites employee perspective and identifies at least one root cause
Agrees on a time-bound plan with measurement and follow-up
bonus_points: Co-creates a simple checklist or review workflow
Balances accountability with support (training, pairing, resources)
Ends with a concise summary of next steps and dates
sticky_notes: KEY: Specific examples + impact, then coaching plan.
TRAP: Don’t compare them to others or argue about fairness.
HINT: Agree on ‘definition of done’ and a repeatable quality checklist.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Employee accepts feedback if you stay specific and fair, listen to their perspective, and agree on a clear improvement plan with support and weekly check-ins
